format: UCWDC Couples, finality of judging decisions

source.quote_free_summary: All decisions of the contest judges, the Contest Coordinator and the Event Director are final.

requirement: A UCWDC profile must PROHIBIT unilateral manager reversal of published official judging decisions; DanceFlow must not offer a manager override of a judging decision.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI, report generation.
interpretation_notes: 'Final' is not defined for clerical or computational errors in the text read. Clerical or computational corrections (the scoring software mis-tabulating recorded marks) must be distinguished from challenges to judging decisions. No UCWDC authority to correct published results is invented; where the sources are silent, any correction authority would be DanceFlow or organizer policy, labelled so.
decision_refs: OD-22 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A for future WSDC support, with UCWDC correction-authority restrictions; retrospective audit PR #795)
